milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because when the player breaks an allium flower block, it drops an 'allium' item that enters their inventory. The player starts with no allium in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms they mined one.

Uses inventory_has because hay bales drop themselves as 'hay_block' items when mined (no tool required, just slow by hand). The player starts with no hay_block in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms they mined one.

Uses inventory_has for emerald because the player starts with 0 emeralds and gains 1 emerald by trading 1 red dye to the shepherd villager. Having ≥1 emerald confirms at least one successful sale occurred. The shepherd at (~8,1,0) has a custom trade: 1 red_dye → 1 emerald.

Uses inventory_has for emerald with min_count=2 because the player gains a second emerald by trading 1 pink dye to the shepherd villager. Requiring ≥2 emeralds inherently enforces that sell Red Dye (which provides the first emerald) was completed before this milestone can trigger. The shepherd has a custom trade: 1 pink_dye → 1 emerald.
